tagline.en: Pandora — a diffusion-based interactive world model that generates video worlds you can steer with text.
tagline.zh: Pandora——基于扩散的交互式世界模型，生成可用文本引导的视频世界。

en: Pandora, from the maitrix-org project, is a diffusion-based world model that generates video and lets you steer the unfolding world with text. It sits between text-to-video generation and interactive world modeling.

In WorldFoundry the Pandora runtime is vendored in-tree, including the core model together with its ChatUniVi and DynamiCrafter components, exposed through a shared runtime plan wrapper for diffusion-world-model, world-generation, and text-to-video tasks.
Because the official weights aren't openly distributed, full generation is gated on caller-provided, official-compatible checkpoints that you stage locally.
zh: Pandora 出自 maitrix-org 项目，是一个基于扩散的世界模型，能生成视频并让你用文本引导世界的演化。它介于文生视频生成与交互式世界建模之间。
在 WorldFoundry 中，Pandora 运行时以内置形式提供，包含核心模型及其 ChatUniVi 与 DynamiCrafter 组件，通过统一的运行时计划封装暴露，支持扩散世界模型、世界生成与文生视频任务。
由于官方权重未公开分发，完整生成需要你在本地提供官方兼容的 checkpoint。

whenToUse.en: Use Pandora when you want a diffusion world model that generates video and responds to text-based control of the unfolding scene.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个基于扩散、能生成视频并响应文本控制场景演化的世界模型时，可以使用 Pandora。

notFor.en: The official weights aren't openly available, so full generation depends on official-compatible checkpoints you supply yourself.
notFor.zh: 官方权重未公开，完整生成依赖你自行提供的官方兼容 checkpoint。
